title: The lower density bound makes the transversal measure purely atomic with atoms ≥ c: ν is a countable sum of weighted parallel planes
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, c > 0, V ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with dim V = n, σ a Borel measure on ℝ^P with σ(ℝ^P∖V^⊥) = 0 and σ(K) < ∞ for compact K, and ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P with ν(A) = ∫⁻_{t∈V}σ({y : t + y ∈ A}) dHⁿ(t) for every Borel A (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Assume ofReal c ≤ liminf_{r→0+} ν(B_r(y))/(ω_n·rⁿ) for ν-a.e. y (ω_n = unitBallVolume n). Then there is a countable set Z ⊆ V^⊥ with σ({w}) ≥ ofReal c for every w ∈ Z and ν = Σ_{w∈Z}σ({w})·Hⁿ⌞{y : y − w ∈ V} (Measure.sum indexed by Z).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → Module.finrank ℝ V = n → σ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → σ K < ∞) → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in (V : Set (Euclid P)), σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ENNReal.ofReal c ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => ν (ball y r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → ∃ Z : Set (Euclid P), Z.Countable ∧ Z ⊆ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ (∀ w ∈ Z, ENNReal.ofReal c ≤ σ {w}) ∧ ν = Measure.sum (fun w : Z => σ {(w : Euclid P)} • (μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ V})
